name: @fidesbuild/mcp-server

tools.name: fides_status
tools.description: The loaded FIDES: whether it is active, the budget spent and remaining, the FIDES Account balance, the allowed contracts and the expiry. Also gives this computer's agent address: use it when the user asks for their FIDES agent address. With no FIDES loaded, explains how to set one up.

tools.name: fides_setup
tools.description: Use when the user wants to set up FIDES, connect their wallet or sign a new FIDES. Returns this computer's agent address and a link to the FIDES app with it filled in, where the user sets the limits and signs. The signed FIDES is then picked up automatically. To let the user buy from paid APIs (fides_pay_request), pass the services with a spending cap each; for FIDES's own paid demo use id "fides-demo".

id.description: A name for the paid service, e.g. "fides-demo"

max.description: Most the agent may spend on it, in USDG, e.g. "0.1"

tools.name: fides_use_file
tools.description: Only needed if the user has a fides.json file: loads a signed FIDES from a path on this computer, checks that it is for this computer's agent key, and keeps a copy. FIDES signed in the app are picked up without this.

path.description: Full path to the fides.json file, e.g. C:\Users\me\Downloads\fides.json

tools.name: fides_plan
tools.description: Builds the actions into one execution plan: checks every action against the FIDES, groups what can go out together, and simulates it against the chain. Sends nothing. Returns a plan_id for fides_execute. Show the result to the user before executing.

kind.description: "transfer" sends a token from the FIDES Account. "call" calls an allowed contract with raw calldata.

amount.description: transfer: how much, in whole token units, e.g. "1.5". call: how much of the budget token the call spends, if any

token.description: transfer: the token address. Defaults to the FIDES's budget token

data.description: call: hex calldata, starting with the 4-byte function selector

label.description: A short description shown in the plan

tools.name: fides_pay_request
tools.description: Fetches a URL from a paid API that charges per request over x402, paying from the FIDES budget. Reads the price first and refuses if it is over the service's cap in the FIDES or over max_price. Moves exactly the price from the FIDES Account to the agent key, pays, and returns the response. The service must be in the FIDES (its services list). For FIDES's own demo, the URL is https://api.fidesbuilder.xyz/v1/demo/chain-stats and the service is "fides-demo". Tell the user the price and get their OK before paying unless they already asked you to buy it.

service.description: The service id in the FIDES. Can be left out if the FIDES has exactly one service

max_price.description: Refuse if the price is above this, in USDG

tools.name: fides_execute
tools.description: Executes a plan made by fides_plan, by its plan_id. Only the actions inside the FIDES are sent; blocked ones never are. Moves real funds from the FIDES Account: confirm with the user first.

tools.name: fides_receipts
tools.description: Every bundle executed onchain under the loaded FIDES, with transaction links, and the budget spent.

instructions: FIDES lets you act with the owner's funds only inside limits the owner signed (a FIDES): a budget, allowed contracts and functions, and an expiry. Funds move from the owner's FIDES Account, never from the owner's wallet. If no FIDES is set up yet, call fides_setup and give the user the link. Always call fides_plan first and show the user what is inside the FIDES, what is blocked and why, and ask before calling fides_execute. Actions outside the FIDES are blocked before anything is sent. Amounts are in whole token units, like "1.5".
